notes: ACNS-X05_rater_manual (Phase P02, RQ3): pre-registered inter-rater coder manual for the SoK's evidence-boundary coding at research/venue2027/acns/design/rater_manual.md (manual_version 1.0.0, contract clara.venue2027.acns.rater-manual.v1). Defines each BND_* code from the frozen protocol rubric (BND_VALID, BND_OVERREAD, BND_UNDERREAD, BND_INDETERMINATE) with definition, derivation rule and constructed anchor examples; elaborates the C1-C8 dimensions fixed by sok_review_protocol.md section 6 (Claim extraction, Evidence class, Lattice level claimed, Lattice level demonstrated, Observer axis, Trust axis, Claim type, Ambiguity flag) with decision rules and anchors; gives the D1-D9 decision tree deriving boundary codes from C1 plus C2-C6 fields; INDETERMINATE rules IND1-IND7 (retained, never coerced; C8=AMB couples to undecidable fields; BND_INDETERMINATE is reserved for under-determined inputs, not a doubt escape hatch); stable reason codes (EXTRACT_NO_VERBATIM, EXTRACT_NO_LOCATOR, FIELD_UNDECIDABLE, BOUNDARY_REOPENED, CONFLICT_ADJUDICATION_REQUIRED, ADJ_UNAVAILABLE, MANUAL_AMENDMENT_POST_FREEZE); JSON-serializable coding record schema clara.venue2027.acns.coding-record.v1; and the inter-rater agreement protocol: two independent human coders under pseudonymous roles C1/C2 plus a third-coder adjudicator, blind allocation over the full claim set, 20-source pilot revised during development only and frozen before main labels, sealed first-pass streams, kappa computed on the pre-adjudication stream with adjudicated labels reported separately, 14-day adjudication window with ADJ_UNAVAILABLE retention, and all numeric thresholds delegated to rq_and_estimands.yaml/ACNS-rq_registry/ACNS-freeze. No kappa/agreement value, no rater identity and no run id is asserted anywhere: no coding run, pilot session or adjudication session has been executed; every observed statistic enters later via artifacts/venue2027/acns/<run_id>/manifest.json after ACNS-freeze. All anchor sentences are constructed teaching examples, not corpus quotations. Test driver research/venue2027/acns/tests/test_rater_manual.py (stdlib-only besides pytest, 44 tests) machine-checks: manual exists and is version-stamped; all required sections; every protocol BND_* code documented with its own subsection, definition, derivation and >=2 anchors; all C1-C8 dimensions present with names matching the protocol, each with decision rules and an anchor; lattice levels L0-L4 and six evidence classes and observer positions consistent with the protocol/threat model; ordered decision tree deriving all four BND codes; INDETERMINATE section with >=5 numbered rules and no-coercion markers; required reason codes; coding-record fields; agreement-protocol markers; and negative controls - no fabricated kappa/agreement numbers (regex over kappa=0.xx style and percent patterns), no invented rater/reviewer names (pseudonymous role tokens only), no invented run ids, no placeholder text, plus execution-honesty statement. 44 passed; uvx ruff@0.7.1 check clean on research/venue2027/acns/. Deliverable path note: the task manifest names annotation_handbook.md; the orchestrator-directed path rater_manual.md delivers the same document and the manual records this mapping for downstream tasks (ACNS-X06 consumes it). baseline_parity=NOT_APPLICABLE (coding instrument, not a decision comparator; baseline arms B0-B3 enter via RQ3's executed coding sessions downstream). source_sha_after records the base commit 11a9219c per the established sibling convention; the single task commit SHA is created immediately after this report and recorded in the commit body. Downstream consumers: ACNS-X06_adjudication, ACNS-X07_witness_gallery, RQ1/RQ3 agreement statistics, ACNS-X10_sok_synthesis.
